legacyPlayer.title: Legacy player
legacyPlayer.subtitle: Go back to playing through the server
legacyPlayer.enableDesc: By default, films play directly in the browser without asking the server for anything. This option goes back to the old path: the server negotiates the stream and transcodes when it has to. Slower to start and costly for the server, but it is the well-worn path — turn it on if you run into a playback problem.

help.title: Known issues
help.hdrTitle: HDR films look washed out on Firefox (Linux)
help.hdrIntro: Firefox does not yet display HDR correctly on Linux. It knows how: the option exists, it is simply off by default.
help.hdrStep1: Open a new tab, type about:config and accept the warning.
help.hdrStep3: Set it to true, then restart Firefox.
help.hdrNote: This is a Firefox setting, not one of this app's, and it undoes just as easily. Other browsers are unaffected.
